steps.name: mixed
steps.note: 20% health, 30% search, 30% chat, 10% ingest, 5% agent, 5% team

steps.name: llm_failures_30pct
steps.note: 30% of model calls return 500 (client retries once)

steps.name: llm_timeouts
steps.note: every model call hangs 30 s, client timeout 5 s (+1 retry): requests should fail, not hang (api restarted afterwards with the default 10 s timeout)

steps.name: thread_starvation
steps.note: FastAPI runs sync handlers in a 40-thread pool per worker (2 workers = 80). 120 chats each holding a thread for ~16 s (two 8 s model calls) saturate it.

steps.name: qdrant_interruption
steps.note: Qdrant stopped for 20 s under search+chat load; chat must keep answering without retrieval

steps.name: extraction_docx
steps.note: 400-paragraph DOCX; extraction slots 2/process x 2 workers, 5 s queue

steps.name: rate_limit_default
steps.note: shipped limits (120/min per identity and per address): 429s are the expected, correct outcome
